CD_SECTOR_BYTES.description: Number of PCM bytes in a raw audio CD sector.

CD_LOOKUP_PORT.description: TCP port for the HTTP v2 CD recognition API and hosted artwork.

CD_LOOKUP_PACKET_BYTES.description: Maximum encoded CD recognition request size in bytes.

CD_LOOKUP_TYPE.description: JSON type identifier for a CD table-of-contents request.

CD_LOOKUP_VERSION.description: Version selected by the HTTP API path and returned in response envelopes.

CD_SECTORS_PER_SECOND.description: Number of audio CD sectors per second, used to convert offsets to durations.

CD_LEAD_IN_SECTORS.description: Offset added to LBA positions to obtain absolute CD sector positions.

CD_MAX_TRACKS.description: Maximum number of tracks supported in an audio CD table of contents.

CD_LOOKUP_ARTWORK_PENDING.description: Artwork preparation or an artwork-only retry is pending; poll the lookup result.

CD_LOOKUP_ARTWORK_AVAILABLE.description: Artwork is available at a hosted cover path.

CD_LOOKUP_ARTWORK_UNAVAILABLE.description: No artwork will be supplied for this lookup; retain labels and the placeholder.

CD_LOOKUP_RESPONSE_BYTES.description: Maximum HTTP API JSON response body size in bytes.

CD_LOOKUP_COVER_BYTES.description: Maximum compressed CD cover JPEG size in bytes; other artwork retains its own limit.

CD_LOOKUP_COVER_SIDE.description: Maximum width or height of a prepared CD cover, preserving aspect ratio without enlargement.

CD_LOOKUP_MAX_RETRY_SECONDS.description: Maximum retry delay and advertised no-match cache lifetime in HTTP v2, in seconds (seven days).
